precheck.description: check RLS is not already enabled on "TenantSetting"
precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_class" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."relnamespace" WHERE ("n"."nspname" = $1 AND "c"."relname" = $2 AND NOT ("c"."relrowsecurity"))) AS "result"

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."TenantSetting" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

postcheck.description: verify row-level security is enabled on "TenantSetting"
postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_class" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."relnamespace" WHERE ("n"."nspname" = $1 AND "c"."relname" = $2 AND "c"."relrowsecurity")) AS "result"

precheck.description: ensure RLS policy "tenant_setting_isolation_c516f4ff" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "tenant_setting_isolation_c516f4ff" ON "public"."TenantSetting" AS PERMISSIVE FOR ALL TO PUBLIC USING ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)) WITH CHECK ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true))

postcheck.description: verify RLS policy "tenant_setting_isolation_c516f4ff" exists with the planned command, roles and permissiveness
postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3 AND "cmd" = $4 AND "permissive" = $5 AND (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(role_name ORDER BY role_name), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT policy_role::text COLLATE "C" AS role_name FROM unnest("roles") AS policy_role) AS actual_roles) = (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(role_name ORDER BY role_name), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT (CASE expected_role WHEN 'current_user' THEN current_user::text WHEN 'current_role' THEN current_role::text WHEN 'session_user' THEN session_user::text ELSE expected_role END) COLLATE "C" AS role_name FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(($6)::jsonb) AS expected_role) AS expected_roles))) AS "result"
